name: @om-data-mapper/class-transformer
description: class-transformer compatibility adapter for om-data-mapper: Expose/Exclude/Type/Transform decorators and plainToInstance on TC39 decorator metadata, zero dependencies.
author: Isqanderm <aleksandr.melnik.personal@gmail.com> (https://www.linkedin.com/in/isqander-melnik)

scripts.build: rm -rf build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node ../../scripts/fix-esm-imports.js && echo '{"type":"module"}' > build/esm/package.json
